name: SM ENTERTAINMENT JAPAN Co.,Ltd.
summary: SM ENTERTAINMENT JAPAN Co., Ltd. is active in Japan in satellite (CS) broadcasting, artist management, mobile services, fan clubs, merchandise, events and concerts, music and rights, organized in Entertainment and Rights & Media segments. It runs KNTV, a Korean entertainment channel broadcasting dramas, news, K-pop and variety shows, and plans and produces original programs. Formerly Stream Media Corporation, it took its present name in June 2025.
